pairs.subject: voice-io
pairs.evidence: app/features/setup-studio/VoicePanel.tsx:58 The first-run voice step lists cloud engines (ElevenLabs) beside local ones (Piper/Kokoro) with only a name, languages and state. Nothing says text leaves the machine, no heard local default is recommended, and the flow has no hearing (recognizer) step — contrary to voice-setup-experience rules 1 and 4.

techniques.evidence: app/features/setup-studio/VoicePanel.tsx:58 The cards carry no residency label (TtsProvider in protocol.ts:332 has no local/cloud field). There is no curated local default, the first preview does not select, the sample is pinned to 'en' (line 171), and grep finds no STT/recognizer step in setup-studio or onboard-ui. Positive: skip is always visible and leaving stops playback.
app/features/setup-studio/VoicePanel.tsx:8 absent, broken and ready are rendered differently, and absent is not painted as a failure.
app/features/setup-studio/VoicePanel.tsx:186 The host's fallback (x-tts-fallback-from) stays visible at the setup boundary. The host also picks the sample sentence, so the page cannot spend tokens.

app/features/setup-studio/VoicePanel.tsx:182 The panel uses a single Audio element, so a new preview stops the previous one, and unmount pauses it and revokes the URL. There is no latest-wins generation counter, though: the later-returning synthesis wins, not the later-requested one.
